source_introductions.title: Exact Birch–Swinnerton–Dyer Formula from Low Selmer Corank
The Selmer converse for elliptic curves at every prime
The two-primary Birch–Swinnerton–Dyer formula in Selmer corank at most one

manuscript_claims.name: full_BSD
manuscript_claims.claim: For any E/Q and any prime q with full q-primary Selmer corank 0 or 1, analytic/Mordell–Weil ranks equal the corank, Sha is finite, and the normalized full BSD leading coefficient equals Omega*Reg*#Sha*product(Tamagawa)/#torsion^2, with the period and height conventions fixed in source.
manuscript_claims.distinct_obligation: Exact leading-term equality at all primes, not implied by rank equality and finiteness alone.

manuscript_claims.name: all_prime_converse
manuscript_claims.claim: For any E/Q and prime p, full p-primary Selmer corank 0 or 1 implies analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks equal the corank and finiteness of the entire Tate–Shafarevich group.
manuscript_claims.distinct_obligation: Converse does not itself establish the BSD leading-term formula.

manuscript_claims.name: two_primary_BSD
manuscript_claims.claim: For E/Q with 2-primary Selmer corank at most one, ranks agree and Sha finite; BSD quotient Q_E is positive rational and v_2(Q_E)=v_2(#Sha).
manuscript_claims.distinct_obligation: Only the valuation at 2, not all odd-prime valuations.
